en.askTitle: Swap in your dog's records, dates and housing, and get a backward-timed Shanghai-to-Singapore dog move plan
en.runTitle: Moving a 4-year-old dog from Shanghai to Singapore in June 2027: import rules, timeline and costs

fields.label: Breed photos, weight, measurements and sterilisation status
fields.value: 4 years old, 18 kg, mixed breed with no restricted-breed ancestry they know of

fields.label: Housing permission
fields.value: May rent either an HDB flat or a private condo

fields.label: Quarantine acceptance
fields.placeholder: e.g. fine with a stay of at least 30 days at the quarantine centre

fields.label: Flight and crate options
fields.placeholder: e.g. checked baggage on a direct Shanghai–Singapore flight, large airline crate

fields.label: Itemised agent and freight quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. a relocation agent's quote listing every line, in CNY

en.template: Plan our Shanghai-to-Singapore dog move for {dates} using {records}, {breed}, {housing}, {quarantine}, {flight} and {quotes}. Work backwards from export, separate confirmed requirements from open checks, and show costs without double-counting or hiding unpriced extras. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing documents or submitting anything.

phases.title: Read the official rules for importing, housing, export from China and transport
phases.note: Singapore's import and quarantine rules, dog licensing and housing rules, Shanghai customs and airline pet policies
phases.judgment: Two pages of the same airline disagreed on when it would refuse a pet in hot weather. It wrote down both versions and the exact difference, and did not treat acceptance of the dog on a June 2027 flight as confirmed.

phases.title: Write the guide with a recommendation, a backward timeline and a fully sourced cost table
Independent check of every claim and sum, then desktop and phone layout checks
phases.judgment: The independent audit confirmed that the sums and dates matched, but it would not give an overall pass. It listed what is still open, for example a mismatch between two Singapore government portals and how long the Chinese customs permit stays valid.

workers: Read the public rules for exporting a pet dog from Shanghai, and which airports and airlines carry dogs as checked baggage or cargo
Read Singapore's rules on dog housing, breed and size, the adoption scheme limits, licence fees, and quarantine and agent charges
Independent audit: recomputed every money figure and date, checked each rule claim against the source notes, and listed what is still unconfirmed

zh.askTitle: 换成你家狗狗的记录、日期和住房情况，就能得到一份按出口日期倒排的上海到新加坡宠物犬搬家方案
zh.runTitle: 2027 年 6 月把 4 岁的狗从上海带到新加坡：入境规定、时间表和费用

fields.label: 芯片、疫苗和抗体记录
fields.value: 已植入芯片，在上海打过疫苗

fields.label: 犬种照片、体重、尺寸和绝育状态
fields.value: 4 岁，18 公斤，混种，据他们所知没有限制犬种的血统

fields.label: 住房许可
fields.value: 组屋（HDB）或私人公寓都可能租

fields.label: 隔离接受确认
fields.placeholder: 例如：可以接受在检疫中心住至少 30 天

fields.label: 航班和航空箱方案
fields.placeholder: 例如：上海直飞新加坡，托运，用大号航空箱

fields.label: 代理和货运分项报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：搬家代理逐项列出的人民币报价

zh.template: 请按 {dates}，结合 {records}、{breed}、{housing}、{quarantine}、{flight} 及 {quotes}，规划上海到新加坡的宠物犬搬家。按出口日期倒排，区分已确认要求和待核实事项，避免费用重复，也不要隐藏未定价的额外费用。联系他人、分享文件或提交任何东西前，先问我。

phases.title: 读进口、住房、中国出口和运输方面的官方规定
phases.note: 新加坡进口和检疫规定、养犬登记和住房规则、上海海关和航空公司的宠物政策
phases.judgment: 同一家航空公司的两个页面，对高温天气什么时候拒收宠物说法不一致。它把两种说法和具体差异都写了下来，没有把 2027 年 6 月航班接收这条狗当成已确认。

phases.title: 写出带推荐、倒排时间表和完整来源费用表的指南
独立核对每条说法和每笔金额，再检查电脑和手机上的页面
phases.judgment: 独立审核确认金额和日期都对得上，但没有给出整体通过，并列出还没解决的事项，例如新加坡两个政府网站之间的出入，以及中国海关许可证的有效期。

workers: 读上海出口宠物犬的公开规定，以及哪些机场和航空公司可以托运或走货运运狗
读新加坡对养犬住房、犬种和体型的规定、领养计划限制、养犬执照费，以及检疫和代理收费
独立审核：重算每一笔金额和日期，逐条对照来源笔记检查规则说法，并列出仍未确认的事项
